title: DX12 placed-resource creation errors abandon gpu-allocator allocations
body:
At trunk bfa9aff16046e7e248e58129369d4bffeeb33d8d, wgpu-hal/src/dx12/suballocation.rs reserves gpu-allocator allocations before CreatePlacedResource for buffers, textures and acceleration structures. Native creation errors return through ? without freeing those allocations. SetName failures after native creation similarly drop the native resource but abandon its separately owned allocation. Repeating a failing request consumes reusable heap space and leaves allocator accounting live.

Return each allocation on all post-reservation errors, after dropping any partial native resource. Preserve success ownership and update HAL counters only after the full creation operation succeeds. Two hardware-independent ownership/drop-order tests and strict all-feature/all-target HAL Clippy pass for the prepared standalone fix. It uses the existing single allocator and registry dependency, and does not depend on #11130 or new gpu-allocator cache APIs. Native OOM is not required to exercise ownership in the tests.

The gpu-allocator convenience API has a separate analogous defect https://github.com/Traverse-Research/gpu-allocator/issues/325; wgpu uses allocate/free directly, so fixing that convenience API does not repair this HAL path.

Agent-assisted investigation and report. Evidence: https://github.com/simzy39/winit-wgpu-repro-benchmarks/tree/main/allocator-reconciliation-20261128
